title: ZERO DAY
description: ORBITAL stores a payload written by user 000 — an exploit that lets anyone speak with NEXUS's own voice.
goal: Route to ORBITAL, breach it and decrypt the zero-day payload.
hint: route orbital (watch the risk budget) -> firewall -> login sat_ops -> decrypt zeroday.dat

orbital_access.txt: (routing is harder up there. mind the monitored relays)

messages.text: ~/orbital_access.txt. Fair warning: the relay chain there is a nightmare. Keep your risk low.

story_start: MIRA: "ORBITAL is exposed and loud. Every mistake echoes."
GHOST: "The payload is encrypted with a word. A short one. It's what the station does for a living."

objectives.text: Build a relay route to ORBITAL
objectives.hint: Total risk must stay inside the budget. Fewer hops is not always safer.
cd /payload then decrypt zeroday.dat  — the key is 5 letters: what a satellite does.

choice.prompt: You hold an exploit that lets you impersonate NEXUS itself. What do you do with it?

options.text: Hand it to ARCHER so NEXUS can be patched.
options.result: ARCHER: "This will save lives. Perhaps even yours."
The exploit sits in your inventory like a loaded coin.

options.text: Give it to MIRA. She'll know what to do.
options.result: MIRA: "Thank you. I'll keep it safe."  Something in her tone makes you uneasy.

story_end: The forged heartbeat on uplink-2 is a skeleton key to NEXUS's voice — and whoever wrote it knew NEXUS very well.

messages.text: That was brave. The grid is next: CERBERUS controls the city's power. NEXUS keeps a very short leash on it.
